title: Canticle of Daniel (All you works oft he Lord)
content:
1.
All you works of the Lord, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

2.
angels of the Lord, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

3.
heavens of the Lord, O bless the Lord.
clouds of the sky, O bless the Lord.
armies of the Lord, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

4.
sun and moon, O bless the Lord.
stars of the heavens, O bless the Lord.
And you, showers and rain, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

5.
breezes and winds, O bless the Lord.
fire and heat, O bless the Lord.
And you, cold and heat, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

6.
showers and dew, O bless the Lord.
frosts and cold, O bless the Lord.
And you, frost and snow, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

7.
night-time and day, O bless the Lord.
darkness and light, O bless the Lord.
And you, lightning and clouds, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

8.
let the earth bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

9.
mountains and hills, O bless the Lord.
all plants of the earth, O bless the Lord.
And you, fountains and springs, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

10.
rivers and seas, O bless the Lord.
creatures of the sea, O bless the Lord.
every bird in the sky, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

11.
beasts, wild and tame, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

12.
children of men, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

13.
Israel, O bless the Lord.
priests of the Lord, O bless the Lord.
servants of the Lord, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

14.
spirits and souls of the just, O bless the Lord.
holy and humble of heart, O bless the Lord.
Ananias, Azarias, Mizael, O bless the Lord.

To him be highest glory and praise for ever.

15.
praise the Father, the Son and Holy Spirit:

To you be highest glory and praise for ever.

16.
May you be blessed, O Lord, in the heavens:

To you be highest glory and praise for ever.
